round_interpretation: All 89 audited historical masks have complete three-seed results. The 16-input no-lag/no-MA/no-ERP parent has IC 0.319444, NLL -2.698793 and Sharpe 0.849882. The best-Sharpe point is larger and trades worse IC/NLL for a small Sharpe increase; the best-NLL anchor uses a different input family including lag. Existing exact neighbors already test adding MA, ERP, the gold/oil ratio and removing CPI monthly change. This round therefore targets eight previously untested individual removals, two coherent two-feature reductions, and two genuinely new rate/representation hypotheses. Do not force lag removal or confuse the old zero-filled credit history with proof against genuine HY inputs.

selection.sharpe_definition: mean(monthly excess return) / sample_std(monthly excess return) * sqrt(12)
